facts.text: It was the capital of the Sluis sector, in the Outer Rim Territories.

evidence.quote: It was the capital of the Sluis sector, in the Outer Rim Territories.

facts.text: It was the site of an extensive deep-space docking facility and shipyard, the largest and most impressive in the area.

evidence.quote: It was the site of an extensive deep-space docking facility and shipyard, the largest and most impressive in the area.

facts.text: The docking station was defended by perimeter battle stations, while the shipyards were managed by an outer system defense network as well as the Sluis Control.

evidence.quote: The docking station was defended by perimeter battle stations, while the shipyards were managed by an outer system defense network as well as the Sluis Control.

facts.text: The Sluissi were long supporters of the Galactic Republic, with Sluis Van being home to a vital network of Republic shipyards that were destroyed by the Sith during the Great Galactic War.
entities: Battle of Sluis Van (Great Galactic War)

evidence.quote: The Sluissi were long supporters of the Galactic Republic, with Sluis Van being home to a vital network of Republic shipyards that were destroyed by the Sith during the Great Galactic War.

facts.text: Millennia later, during the final years of the Republic, they became disgusted with the Galactic Senate whom they blamed as being massively corrupt and causing galaxy-wide injustice.

evidence.quote: Millennia later, during the final years of the Republic, they became disgusted with the Galactic Senate whom they blamed as being massively corrupt and causing galaxy-wide injustice.

facts.text: The planet was represented in the Galactic Senate by Bor Gracus in 33 BBY and then Corlissi Ludar, until 22 BBY, when Sluis Van seceded during the Separatist Crisis.

evidence.quote: The planet was represented in the Galactic Senate by Bor Gracus in 33 BBY and then Corlissi Ludar, until 22 BBY, when Sluis Van seceded during the Separatist Crisis.

facts.text: During the Clone Wars, Sluis Van was located in Separatist space and the Sluis Van shipyards produced starships for the Confederate forces.

evidence.quote: During the Clone Wars, Sluis Van was located in Separatist space and the Sluis Van shipyards produced starships for the Confederate forces.

facts.text: However, in 20 BBY, the system was blockaded by a massive Separatist fleet to block any Republic reinforcements in the area, particularly during the Battle of Praesitlyn.

evidence.quote: However, in 20 BBY, the system was blockaded by a massive Separatist fleet to block any Republic reinforcements in the area, particularly during the Battle of Praesitlyn.

facts.text: At the end of the Clone Wars, the Sluis Van system had become a Separatist stronghold.

evidence.quote: At the end of the Clone Wars, the Sluis Van system had become a Separatist stronghold.

facts.text: As well as many other Confederate worlds, it was besieged by Republic forces during the Outer Rim Sieges.

evidence.quote: As well as many other Confederate worlds, it was besieged by Republic forces during the Outer Rim Sieges.

facts.text: Sluis Van held off the Republic.

evidence.quote: Sluis Van held off the Republic.

evidence.quote: During the Imperial Period, Sluis Van was a major Imperial shipyard and was heavily guarded.

evidence.quote: By 4 ABY, the planet had become an Imperial fortress world under control of Superior General Sander Delvardus.

facts.text: Sluis Van was liberated by the New Republic in 5 ABY.

evidence.quote: Sluis Van was liberated by the New Republic in 5 ABY.

facts.text: Despite the Sluis Van Congregate not wanting to cut all connections to the Empire, being as it was one of their largest shipyard clients, the planet joined the New Republic several months after the death of Emperor Palpatine.

evidence.quote: Despite the Sluis Van Congregate not wanting to cut all connections to the Empire, being as it was one of their largest shipyard clients, the planet joined the New Republic several months after the death of Emperor Palpatine.

evidence.quote: During the Thrawn campaign, the Sluis Van Shipyards were one of the main shipyards of the New Republic.

evidence.quote: The planet was the site of a battle with Grand Admiral Thrawn during his campaign against the New Republic.

facts.text: Sluis Van Orbital Dock V-475 was a Rendili StarDrive Space Dock that was part of the Sluis Van Shipyards. It was the site of the beginning of the Battle of Sluis Van as the freighter Nartissteu exploded close to the station.

facts.text: The Sluis Van Outer Starfighter Base was a New Republic military installation located near Sluis Van in the Sluis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Although primarily used as a starfighter base, flight instruction was also undertaken at the installation.

evidence.quote: The Sluis Van Outer Starfighter Base was a New Republic military installation located near Sluis Van in the Sluis sector of the Outer Rim Territories. Although primarily used as a starfighter base, flight instruction was also undertaken at the installation.

facts.text: When the technologically-advanced Sluissi species joined the infantile Galactic Republic, they established several major shipyards throughout the Sluis sector. Once such space station was the high-tech Sluis Van Central space station.

facts.text: The Battle of Sluis Van, also known as the Battle at Sluis Van Shipyards, was the first major military conflict of the Thrawn campaign, orchestrated by Grand Admiral Thrawn to steal a flotilla of New Republic ships.
